// Deliberate violations of the strict XState profile, one per machine rule.
// tests/xstate-profile-guard.test.ts checks this as a `*-machine.ts` file.
// Not a .ts file, so neither tsc nor oxlint reads it.
import { setup, types } from "xstate";
// machine-file: a machine file imports no React.
import { useEffect } from "react";

const s = setup({
  schemas: {
    context: types<{ n: number }>(),
    events: { go: types<{}>(), stop: types<{}>() },
  },
  actions: { log: (_: { n: number }) => {} },
  // setup-shape: setup takes schemas, actions and states only.
  guards: { ok: () => true },
  states: { idle: {}, running: {} },
});

export const badMachine = s.createMachine({
  context: { n: 0 },
  initial: "idle",
  states: {
    idle: {
      // state-shape: a state takes on, after and description only.
      entry: () => {},
      on: {
        // transition-function: a handler is a function.
        go: { target: "running" },
        // named-effects: an effect is enq(actions.name, params).
        stop: (_, enq) => {
          enq(() => console.log("stop"));
        },
      },
    },
    running: {
      on: {
        // literal-target: target is a string literal.
        go: () => ({ target: ["id", "le"].join("") }),
      },
      // flat-states: no child states (#5921 workaround).
      states: { inner: {} },
    },
  },
});
void useEffect;
